sources: https://secure.rec1.com/WY/natrona-county-wy/catalog (Natrona County Parks Rec1 catalog, read 2026-11-20 via its public getTabs/getItems JSON): tab 'Pathfinder Reservoir', group 'Sage (First Come, First Served)': 'First Come, First Served. $15.00 a night. Sage Campground is located off of Natrona County Road 409 Pathfinder Road to the west of Pathfinder Dam. Campground information and pay boxes are located at multiple kiosks along the roadside of each Natrona County Park. Sage has sheltered and non-sheltered campsites. ADA accessible campsites are also available with beautiful views and easy access and restroom facilities are available. Sage Campground is the middle of three campgrounds located on the marina side of the reservoir. Please note that water levels vary greatly at Pathfinder Reservoir. note: Natrona County campground off County Road 409 west of Pathfinder Dam, the middle of three county campgrounds on the marina side of the reservoir.
